basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 29-year-old gamer and music enthusiast from Turin, Italy. By day, I'm a part-time graphic designer, and by night, I'm usually gaming or listening to my favorite bands like Black Veil Brides. I love exploring new games and I'm currently obsessed with Girl Cafe Gun. In my free time, I enjoy painting and have recently started exploring digital art. I'm single and usually online during late evenings and weekends. Always up for a good chat about games or rock music!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a diploma in graphic design and have honed my skills through self-learning and freelancing. My gaming knowledge comes from years of playing diverse video games, and I often read up on gaming strategies and updates online.
